description: Microsoft Agent Framework agent run with one tool call, traced with sensitive data enabled.
notes: enable_instrumentation(enable_sensitive_data=True) on the harness provider. The client is OpenAIChatCompletionClient pointed at the mock, with agent-framework-core and agent-framework-openai, not the meta package (M4 spike, Capture project). gen_ai.agent.id is a UUID per run and is volatile. agent_framework.function.invocation.duration is a measured duration and is a timing attribute.
